One item master serves Purchase, Stores, Cost Control, Minibar, Linen & Amenities and Engineering. Item codes are never reused (BR-01). Stock is counted in the stock unit; vendors are paid per purchase unit. Next: create the stores and set the levels for these items.

System – what runs automatically on this screen
  • STS-X01 · Item validation – On every item save and import row: the HSN, category, stock unit and purchase unit must be present, and the code must be unique (BR-01). A name that is the same as or very close to another item gives a warning, not an error.
  • STS-X02 · Setup audit logger – Every new, changed, activated and deactivated item is written to the audit log with user, time, old and new values.
Item added – ST-GRO-041 Black tea powder (CTC) 1 kgSaved as Active in Grocery. STS-X01 check: HSN 0902, category, stock unit and purchase unit present; no other item has a similar name. It can now be used by Purchase, Stores and Cost Control. Written to the setup audit log with the old and new values (STS-X02).
Imported from items-oct-2026.xlsx – 5 items added, 1 skipped6 rows read: 5 new items added (highlighted below), 1 row skipped because ST-ENG-105 AHU pre-filter 24 x 24 in code already exists. STS-X01 check passed on all added rows. Written to the setup audit log with the old and new values (STS-X02).
Template downloadeditems-template.xlsx has one example row and a sheet that lists the valid sub-categories, units and tax classes.
Item deactivatedThe highlighted item stays in history and on stock reports but cannot be used on new requisitions, POs or GRNs. Written to the setup audit log with the old and new values (STS-X02).
Item activatedThe highlighted item can be used on new documents again. Written to the setup audit log with the old and new values (STS-X02).
Item savedChanges saved on the highlighted item. STS-X01 check passed. Purchase, Stores and Cost Control show the new details at once. Written to the setup audit log with the old and new values (STS-X02).
